title: Early Believers and Product-Market Fit
primary_theme: Early-stage founders need believers while searching for product-market fit
founder_lessons: Expect many investors not to see the opportunity before revenue scale makes it obvious.
Use founder and failure stories to learn product-market fit patterns while accounting for survivorship bias.
Be focused on a clear ICP and narrow zero-to-one learning loop.
Understand and communicate the value your product creates, even when ROI is not immediately clean.
notable_quotes: In the early days, especially, you are looking for believers as much as you are looking for investors.
every single early stage founder has the same problem. And it's that they need to find product market fit.
we tell founders like find your ICP, like be super focused, be super niche.
